about_short_description.short_description: Core42 is a developer of foundation models to empower organizations in different industries.

product.name: Sovereign AI Cloud
product.description: A full-stack cloud platform for training, fine-tuning, deploying, and running AI workloads using heterogeneous accelerators, AI-optimized storage, high-speed networking, and sovereign controls.

product.name: Core42 Compass
product.description: An API-driven platform providing access to 50+ AI models, model inference, agent workflows, fine-tuning, governance, and related generative AI capabilities on sovereign infrastructure.

product.name: Sovereign Public Cloud
product.description: A public cloud service combining Microsoft Azure infrastructure with UAE-specific data sovereignty, security, governance, and compliance controls managed through the Core42 Insight application.

product.name: Signature Private Cloud
product.description: A private cloud service hosted in fully owned, in-country data centers for sensitive workloads requiring dedicated infrastructure, local data residency, and sovereign control.

product.name: Delivery Services
product.description: Professional services covering AI and cloud planning, architecture, migration, deployment, and implementation from initial requirements through production delivery.
